The Scottish-born naturalist, conservationist, and writer John Muir (1838-1914)
Here Muir, naturalist, conservationist and rancher, produced most of his significant published works on the flora and fauna of the west.
John Muir Papers, 1856–1942

Correspondence, journals, manuscripts, notes, drawings, and photographs of and by the conservationist, an intellectual precursor of the modern ecology movement and a proponent of the expansion of the national park system.
